audio_format_mp3_note: Re-encodes to MP3. Slower, and slightly worse than the original — for whatever insists on it.
audio_format_original_note: Hands over the track as the site served it — instant, and nothing is lost.
batch_count: {{links}} links — each is downloaded and identified on its own
cancel_all_confirm: Every running and waiting task stops. Downloads keep what they fetched — “Download again” continues each one.
clear_finished_confirm: Finished jobs will be removed from this list. The files they produced are not deleted.
compress_audio_note: Audio only — the result is saved as M4A.
compress_target_hint: The result lands just under the size you asked for.
compress_target_invalid: Enter a size smaller than the file ({{size}}).
compress_target_too_low: That size is very small for this length — the picture will suffer, and the file may end up slightly over.
cookies_hint: Reads the chosen browser's cookies so links behind a login, an age check, or a members-only wall can be downloaded. Close the browser first — Chrome-based ones lock their cookie database while running.
download_as_unknown_hint: Used only if the link turns out to be video or audio.
download_file_not_resumable: This server cannot resume — an interruption starts it over
download_file_note: This link is downloaded exactly as it is — nothing is converted
download_file_resumable: If it stops, it continues from where it left off
download_parallel_hint: Much faster on most sites. Turn it off if a site refuses to download or the file comes out damaged.
download_quality_note: What every video download asks for. If the site does not have it, the closest one below is used.
error_needs_cookies: The site wants a signed-in browser. Choose one under Settings › Downloads › Sign-in cookies.
error_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection or proxy.
error_not_found: Nothing was found at this link (404).
error_not_playlist: This link is not a playlist.
error_rate_limited: The site is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
file_read_failed: This file could not be read: {{reason}}
library_next_to_input: Save edits next to the source file
library_next_to_input_hint: The media tools use the folder the opened file came from instead of the app folder.
library_note: Downloads and results are saved here. Choosing a different folder on a tool screen still applies to that job.
library_organize_hint: Separate folders for video, audio, compressed, trimmed and converted.
library_reset_confirm: New files will be saved to the default folder again. Anything already in the current one stays where it is.
load_failed: Could not load this. The app may still be starting.
needs_audio: This file has no audio to extract.
needs_media: This file has no audio or video to work with.
needs_video: This tool needs a video file
no_internet: No internet connection. Please check your connection.
no_jobs_description: Anything you download or convert shows up here.
no_jobs_hint_file: Drop a file anywhere in this window, or pick one with the button below.
no_jobs_hint_link: Copy a link, then press {{action}} — it will already be filled in.
no_jobs_in_filter_hint: Other tasks are under the other filters.
playlist_all_hint: Each video is queued as its own download, {{slots}} at a time.
proxy_hint: Every download and every link lookup goes through it — yt-dlp and the app alike. Off uses the system's own proxy settings. v2rayN usually listens on 127.0.0.1:10808 (SOCKS5) and 10809 (HTTP).
schedule_hint: Starts {{when}}. Keep the app open until then.
settings_downloads_note: What every link is fetched as, unless a download says otherwise for one link.
settings_general_note: How the app looks and which language it speaks.
settings_network_note: The proxy, how many downloads run at once, and how fast.
simultaneous_downloads_hint: The rest wait their turn. Lowering it never stops a download that is already running.
speed_limit_hint: For all downloads together, so the rest of the connection stays usable.
status_missed: Missed its time — start it now?
tool_compress_about: Make a video or audio file smaller.
tool_convert_about: Change the format so it plays anywhere.
tool_download_about: Save video, audio, or any direct link.
tool_extractAudio_about: Lift the sound out of a video.
tool_not_found: {{tool}} is not available. Try updating it in Settings.
tool_trim_about: Keep the part you want, cut the rest.
tools_bundled_note: These ship inside the app, so nothing needs installing.
trim_exact_hint: Slower, cuts exactly where you asked
trim_fast_hint: Instant, but may start a moment early
welcome_change_later: You can change it any time in Settings.
welcome_language: Choose the language you would like to use.
ytdlp_not_found: The download tool is not available. Try updating it in Settings.
ytdlp_update_note: Sites change how they serve video, and yt-dlp keeps up. Update it if a download stops working.
